2609.22724.title: MATE: Policy-Aware Security Auditing for Mobile Agents via Synthesis-Driven Trajectory Learning
2609.22724.paper_summary: Mobile agents powered by foundation models now automate complex, multi-step workflows on real devices, but their trajectories can violate app-specific security policies. Existing trajectory-level defenses rely on LLM prompting or rigid rules, and thus fail to support fine-grained, natural-language policies that generalize across apps and tasks. In this work, we introduce MATE, a lightweight, policy-conditioned auditor that encodes both agent trajectories and natural-language security policies to determine whether a trajectory violates a given policy and to explain why. Treating policies as editable text rather than fixed model parameters allows MATE to handle user-defined and evolving requirements without retraining. To construct MATE, we build a knowledge base by extracting app descriptions, workflows, and policies from hundreds of popular mobile apps worldwide, and synthesizing over 140K semantically realistic, policy-conditioned trajectories with a multi-stage pipeline. We further release MATEBench, a trajectory-level auditing benchmark with two synthetic subsets and one real-world subset of manually collected trajectories. Models trained with our synthesis-driven trajectory learning achieve over 95% accuracy on MATEBench, retain strong performance on external safety benchmarks, and audit trajectories from Zhipu's AutoGLM and Alibaba's Mobile-Agent on real devices with over 95% accuracy, outperforming prior methods by over 20%. MATE shows that practical, fine-grained security auditing for heterogeneous mobile agents is both feasible and effective.
2609.22724.paper_summary_zh: 行動代理由基礎模型驅動，現在能夠在真實設備上自動化複雜的多步驟工作流程，但它們的軌跡可能會違反應用特定的安全政策。現有的軌跡級別防禦依賴於大型語言模型提示或僵硬的規則，因此無法支持跨應用和任務的細粒度自然語言政策。在這項工作中，我們介紹了MATE，一個輕量級的政策條件審計工具，它編碼了代理的軌跡和自然語言安全政策，以確定軌跡是否違反了給定的政策並解釋原因。將政策視為可編輯的文本而非固定的模型參數，使MATE能夠處理用戶定義和不斷演變的需求，而無需重新訓練。為了構建MATE，我們通過從全球數百個流行的移動應用中提取應用描述、工作流程和政策，並使用多階段管道合成超過14萬條語義上現實的政策條件軌跡來建立知識庫。我們進一步發布了MATEBench，一個具有兩個合成子集和一個手動收集的真實世界子集的軌跡級審計基準。使用我們的合成驅動軌跡學習訓練的模型在MATEBench上達到超過95%的準確率，並在外部安全基準上保持強勁的表現，能夠在真實設備上對Zhipu的AutoGLM和阿里巴巴的Mobile-Agent的軌跡進行審計，準確率超過95%，比以前的方法提高了超過20%。MATE顯示出對異構移動代理進行實用的細粒度安全審計既可行又有效。
